 """Plan local synchronization."""
 
+from pathlib import Path
+
 
 class UnsafeLayoutError(ValueError):
     pass
 
 
+def _overlapping_layout(source: str, destination: str) -> bool:
+    """Return whether either path contains the other.
+
+    Resolving the paths also catches an overlap hidden behind ``..`` or a
+    symlink in an existing parent directory.  Both directions are rejected:
+    a destination below the source can be copied into itself, while a source
+    below the destination can be modified while it is being read.
+    """
+    source_path = Path(source).resolve(strict=False)
+    destination_path = Path(destination).resolve(strict=False)
+    return (
+        source_path == destination_path
+        or source_path in destination_path.parents
+        or destination_path in source_path.parents
+    )
+
